purpose: Teach: 立国/徘徊/潜む/具現/平衡/肥大/抱負/修業

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、平和な立国の理念を警察、引き継ぐ姿勢ですね
lines.en: So with this case, the police seem to be carrying forward the ideal of a peaceful nation.
lines.style: Thoughtful, measured tone. Gentle upward lift at the end—genuinely curious, not challenging. Pauses slightly before speaking, as if turning the thought over first.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、徘徊事案を地域と協力して対応します
lines.en: We handle cases like that by working together with the community.
lines.style: Calm, professional delivery. Even pacing. Direct eye contact. Not cold—steady and grounded, the voice of someone who's done this work long enough to speak about it plainly.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、組織に潜む犯罪を警察、解明されてますね
lines.en: And in this case, it seems the police are working to uncover the crimes that can hide within an organization.
lines.style: Quiet interest underneath. Respectful pause before the main point. Leans slightly into the question—asking genuinely, not testing.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、犯罪のないまちを具現する活動を続けます
lines.en: We continue working to make towns where crime has no place to exist.
lines.style: Firm but not rigid. Conviction in the middle words. Slight emphasis on 'continue'—it's an ongoing commitment, not a one-time effort.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、被害者の平衡感覚を奪った犯罪を警察、扱われてますね
lines.en: In cases like this one, where a crime has taken someone's sense of safety and balance, the police do take it seriously.
lines.style: Softer than before. Acknowledgment of real harm. Slower pace on the middle section. Genuine weight given to the victim's experience.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、組織が肥大する前に摘発します
lines.en: We move to address cases before an organization grows large enough to become deeply rooted.
lines.style: Steady, purposeful. Light emphasis on 'before'—it's about prevention, not just reaction. Professional but not distant.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、若手警官の抱負を警察、聞いてあげて下さい
lines.en: In this case, I'd appreciate it if you could hear out the hopes and ambitions of the younger officers.
lines.style: Gentle request. Respectful but genuine—not performing deference. Opens space for the other person to listen, almost inviting them in.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、修業時代の経験が現場に活きていますね
lines.en: The lessons I learned during my training have stayed with me out in the field.
lines.style: Warm recognition. Quiet pride without boasting. Slower tempo on the opening—he's reflecting on something that mattered. Grounded in real experience.
